description: A directed relationship from a gene silenced by shRNA or knocked out by CRISPR to another gene whose expression decreases significantly in the pooled LINCS L1000 consensus response.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the source–target pair. Negative values indicate decreased target-gene expression.

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each perturbed gene and target-gene tier; retained relationships pass significance at α = 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target-gene evidence tier: landmark genes are directly measured; BING denotes well-inferred genes excluding landmarks.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled expression signatures combined into the perturbed gene’s consensus; an indicator of supporting evidence.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map GEO series GSE92742 (Phase I) and GSE70138 (Phase II). Raw shRNA (trt_sh) and CRISPR knockout (trt_xpr) signatures are pooled by perturbed gene across both series, cell lines, doses, and times. Targets are human landmark and well-inferred non-landmark BING genes; poorly inferred non-BING genes are excluded. Only existing SPOKE Gene endpoints are represented, and source–target self-relationships are excluded. Seed-labeled trt_sh.css and precomputed trt_sh.cgs signatures are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Expression signatures are combined by correlation-weighted Stouffer integration, using landmark-gene correlations for the weights. Significance is assessed separately for landmark and non-landmark BING targets within each perturbed gene. All significant landmark targets are retained; significant BING targets are limited to the top 1,000 per perturbed gene by significance. The relationship summarizes a pooled loss-of-function response across experimental contexts.
